comparison.objective: Thread a lace tip through an eyelet and transfer it between hands; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-object threading, handoff behind a board, and pull-through.
comparison.success_condition: The entire lace tip passes through after the prescribed two-hand transfer.
comparison.reason: Flexible lace threading and handoff are meaningfully different from stabilizing a rigid mandrel, hammer-fracturing tangs, and recovering fragments.
